title: Native card conversion issue summary
description: Summary added to a command result when its diagnostics are limited for display. The issues property on the command result contains the displayed prefix; completeResult points to the saved full result.

totalCount.description: Number of diagnostics in the complete command result.

displayedCount.description: Number of diagnostics retained in the command result issues array.

truncated.description: Whether the command result issues array omits diagnostics present in the saved complete result.

completeResult.description: The unchanged record path returned by the command and containing its complete diagnostics.
